visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy with short, spiky black hair wearing a black t-shirt smiles broadly at the camera against a plain white wall, revealing a slight gap in his front teeth. (2) The scene shifts to the boy lying in a dental chair with a bright green rubber dam over his mouth while a dentist in blue scrubs and white gloves uses a high-speed drill and a dental mirror. (3) A woman with long reddish-brown hair, wearing a yellow t-shirt and a white zip-up hoodie, speaks directly to the camera in a modern living room with a purple sofa in the background. (4) A digital dental X-ray is displayed on a screen, showing the roots of teeth with a red circle highlighting a specific area of decay between the front teeth. (5) The boy, now wearing a red Jurassic Park t-shirt, brushes his teeth in a brightly lit bathroom while the woman helps him with a piece of dental floss. (6) The woman continues her explanation in the living room, making small heart gestures with her fingers and pointing toward the camera with an expressive face. (7) The boy is seated at a white table in a dining area, eating a meal from a Sukiya-branded bowl with a red spoon, looking slightly distracted. (8) A close-up view of the boy's open mouth shows his lower molars clearly under bright light. (9) Another X-ray image shows a detailed view of the child's molars and jawbone structure. (10) Back at the dentist, the practitioner uses a specialized orange light-curing tool inside the boy's mouth while he holds a yellow crown-shaped shield. (11) The woman stands in a bedroom with the boy and a younger toddler in pajamas; the background features white shelves with toys. (12) The boy brushes his teeth again in a bathroom, now wearing cream-colored pajamas with a pattern, using a yellow toothbrush. (13) A product shot features a tube of blue toothpaste and a mint-colored bottle of mouthwash on a white surface with the 'oh care' logo. (14) The woman and boy hold the toothpaste tube towards the camera; a close-up shows the blue toothpaste being squeezed onto a brush and then turning into pink foam in the boy's mouth. (15) The boy swishes mouthwash in his mouth, puffing out his cheeks, and then spits the liquid into a white sink. (16) The video concludes with the woman and boy posing happily while holding the 'oh care' product set in front of them.
